en: A colorized vintage postcard showing a formal landscaped garden framed by multi‑story European-style buildings on both sides. The garden has curved paths, manicured lawns, and flowerbeds forming circular and oval patterns, leading the eye toward the sea or an open horizon in the distance. At the top left, the printed title reads "Alexandrie. Jardin Français." A web watermark "www.elia.org.gr" appears at the bottom right.
